description: This file implements a memory tracking and collection monitoring functionality in Lua. It defines methods to start and stop tracking, and uses metatables with __gc metamethod to observe garbage collection events, optionally marking objects for finalization.

methods.name: M.start
methods.description: Starts the tracking of object collection by enabling the __gc metamethod and creating an initial object.

methods.name: M.stop
methods.description: Stops the tracking, disables the __gc metamethod, and triggers garbage collection to finalize objects.
